crossRefs.note: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.
The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.
I will send him against a profane nation, and against the people who anger me I will give him a command to take the…
“Israel is a hunted sheep. The lions have driven him away. First, the king of Assyria devoured him, and now at last…
How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?
We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.
You will become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where Yahweh will lead you away.
Also I said, “The thing that you do is not good. Shouldn’t you walk in the fear of our God, because of the reproach of…
I will even give them up to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth for evil; to be a reproach and…
I will pursue after them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be tossed…
For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘As my anger and my wrath has been poured out on the inhabitants of…
in that you provoke me to anger with the works of your hands, burning incense to other gods in the land of Egypt, where…
I will take the remnant of Judah, that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to live there, and they will…
Remember, Yahweh, what has come on us. Look, and see our reproach.
“ ‘Moreover I will make you a desolation and a reproach among the nations that are around you, in the sight of all that…
So it will be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment, to the nations that are around you, when I…
Lord, according to all your righteousness, let your anger and please let your wrath be turned away from your city…

translations.web: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.
translations.bsb: All who pass by plunder him; he has become a reproach to his neighbors.
translations.kjv: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.
translations.asv: All that pass by the way rob him: He is become a reproach to his neighbors.
